# Branch Information

## Default Branch: main

This repository uses `main` as the default and primary branch.

**Established:** 2025-11-20

## Branch Strategy

- **main**: Primary development branch and source of truth for production code
- Feature branches: Created from `main` and merged back via pull requests
- All PRs should target the `main` branch unless explicitly stated otherwise

## AI Agent Development

This repository follows an AI-agent-driven development model as outlined in the README. All changes should be made through pull requests to maintain auditability and safe evolution of the codebase.
